premises: Principal elements (Ni, Cr, Mn) in fcc HEAs segregate to grain boundaries at intermediate temperatures
This segregation forms nanoclusters, not large intermetallic precipitates
Reduced cohesion causes a transition from ductile transgranular to brittle intergranular failure
